title: Chapter 1392: 10: Tianyuan, Still Not Coming Out To Meet Your Death?

Chapter 1392: 10: Tianyuan, Still Not Coming Out To Meet Your Death?

Chapter 1392: Chapter 10: Tianyuan, Still Not Coming Out to Meet Your Death?

As for the time loop? The time loop is a test under the operation of the supreme rules.

You only need to pass through it once, regardless of where you are in the world; there is no need to do it again.

“There is still a lot of room for improvement.”

Lin Yuan felt the tiny changes within his body, the transformation of undead matter on his physical form was not yet ninety percent complete.

Moreover, the opening of the infinite Constant Sand Particle World within Lin Yuan is also limited to the particle region that has completed the transformation.

“Boom—”

As Lin Yuan slightly released his breath, it caused the surrounding time and space to collapse. The power of endless ages flowed, even forcing the Origin Rule of this Fang Yuan World to retreat.

“Next, I’ll continue to condense the undead matter and, by the way, retrain my Martial Arts Evolution Road.”

Lin Yuan planned his next steps. At his current level, the so-called retraining of the Martial Arts Evolution Road is merely a matter of making up his mind, with no period of weakness.

And retraining the Martial Arts Evolution Road, besides being more suitable for himself, is more importantly because Lin Yuan wants to see which Divine Skill will awaken in this body.

Before descending to this Fang Yuan World, Lin Yuan watched many future timelines and eventually chose Emperor Tianyuan as his vessel for arrival.

Aside from the fact that Emperor Tianyuan had the highest starting point, it was also because he possessed a special constitution.

The Physical Body Divine Ability cultivated by this constitution would certainly surprise Lin Yuan.

As for what kind of surprise specifically? In future timelines, there are hundreds of possibilities for the Divine Skill he will eventually cultivate.

This is just from the future timelines that Lin Yuan can see. There could be more possibilities in the ones he hasn’t seen.

In most possibilities, the eventually cultivated Physical Body Divine Ability is quite good and can significantly aid Lin Yuan at his current stage.

“This weapon?”

Lin Yuan flipped his right hand, and a mirror appeared in front of him.

This mirror is called the Tianyuan Mirror, an emperor weapon forged with the heart’s blood of Emperor Tianyuan. When fully revived, it will unleash combat power at the threshold of the Great Emperor level.

Generations of Great Emperors generally forge their own emperor weapons.

Firstly, because emperor weapons can enhance one’s combat power.

Secondly, even if they fall and pass, the emperor weapon can be left for descendants to protect the forces they leave behind.

Looking at this mirror, Lin Yuan thought of his own life weapon, the Origin Clock.

It hasn’t been of much use, and regardless of how much Lin Yuan nurtures it, the growth speed of the Origin Clock cannot match the speed of Lin Yuan’s power increase.

“If time allows, let’s enhance the Origin Clock to the thirteenth tier.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, considering his strength and methods, the strongest offensive means is with his fists and feet.

As for weapons? The strongest weapon Lin Yuan has is himself.

But he has to admit that a weapon suitable for himself can indeed enhance combat power and survival methods.

Especially Lin Yuan’s life weapon, the Origin Clock, which specializes in defense. If it can be enhanced to the thirteenth tier, it might also be of some use.

…

Inside the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

Besides Lin Yuan, the current Great Emperor.

There were some followers guarding here as well.

Emperor Tianyuan, knowing his lifespan was running out, dismissed most of his subordinates.

Yet some followers were unwilling to leave, wishing to be buried with the Great Emperor in this palace.

“Great Emperor, that’s the aura of the Great Emperor.”

As Lin Yuan walked through the palace, many followers seemed to sense something, their expressions becoming extremely excited.

They had not felt the Great Emperor’s aura for hundreds of years; if no celestial phenomena arose, they would have thought Emperor Tianyuan had already perished.

When a Great Emperor falls and passes, his own Great Dao collapses, triggering a series of external reactions, known as celestial anomalies.

This is the criterion for determining whether a Great Emperor has perished.

Many forbidden forces of the Great Wilderness Origin World were also waiting for such celestial anomalies to divide the flesh and origin of Emperor Tianyuan.

“Great Emperor, has the Great Emperor lived a third life?”

A follower couldn’t help but speculate.

“A third life?”

Other followers gently shook their heads.

Although they also hoped Emperor Tianyuan would live a third life.

But they knew that for a Great Emperor to live another life, he would have to break the shackles of his own life.

The scale of such an occurrence would not be small. Millions of years ago, when Emperor Tianyuan took the undead medicine and lived a second life, the ensuing shockwave was terrifying.

Only now?

Since Emperor Tianyuan retreated deep into the palace hundreds of years ago, no celestial anomalies have occurred.

Although Emperor Tianyuan wasn’t dead, it certainly wasn’t related to living a third life.

The followers didn’t know that since Lin Yuan’s arrival, the so-called lifespan limit had already been broken.

In this Origin World, for an Emperor level expert to achieve immortality, they must pass the test of the time loop, in order to maintain eternal mental will.

But Lin Yuan’s mental will is inherently that of a time being, having long been capable of eternity, and upon taking over the flesh of Emperor Tianyuan, naturally would not be limited by lifespan.

“Great Emperor…”

A few followers couldn’t help but show expressions of grief in their eyes. With several hundred years of closed-door cultivation without a trace of aura, this aura suddenly appearing at this time.

This part of the followers speculated that Emperor Tianyuan might have already reached the end of his life, and this display of aura was merely a final radiance before passing?

…

You Clan.

Deep within the ancestral land, several lingering You Clan supremes were growing impatient.

According to their calculations, Emperor Tianyuan’s lifespan should have already ended ten years ago.

Yet he persistently held on until now, without any signs of the Dao collapsing and, therefore, without celestial anomalies. This meant Emperor Tianyuan was still alive?

“That old Tianyuan geezer, could he truly live a third life?”

“Impossible. If he could live a third life, he would have already done so. Why wait until now?”

“Perhaps he’s just lucky and endured ten more years, but I doubt he’ll hold out much longer.”

The You Clan supremes quickly discussed.

“What should we do now?”

“Continue waiting?”

The You Clan supremes exchanged a glance.

Since Emperor Tianyuan held out for ten years, he might persist for another ten, or even a hundred years.

Continuing to wait indefinitely was no solution.

“Why don’t we revive early and send off Tianyuan in his final moments?”

One of the You Clan supremes suggested.

They had all been immersed in the Yellow Springs, transforming their flesh into bodies of the Yellow Springs, needing to sleep most of the time. Remaining awake to wait for Emperor Tianyuan’s fall?

They could endure ten or even a hundred years.

But several hundred or a thousand years would be challenging.

“Enough. Even if Tianyuan is alive now, he must be near the end of his lifespan and can’t manifest much power. If we act, there’ll be no real danger.”

The oldest of the You Clan supremes spoke slowly.

Whether a Great Emperor, or Celestial Emperor, or Supreme, nearing the end of lifespan causes mental will to collapse and twist. Even if the physical body remains the same, it can’t exert much combat power.

“Then let us act now.”

The other You Clan supremes said with icy, cruel tones. Harvesting the flesh of a dead Great Emperor clearly lacks the satisfaction of hunting an elder Great Emperor.

Originally, they thought Emperor Tianyuan couldn’t hold out for a few more years, so they were willing to wait.

Yet now, it seemed he could withstand ten years, stretching the patience of the You Clan supremes.

“Let us act.”

The oldest You Clan supreme nodded.

The next moment.

In the depths of the ancestral land of the You Clan, several overwhelming auras extended, enveloping the position of the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

When a supreme acts, even one lingering beyond its time, the ensuing phenomena are extraordinary, immediately attracting the attention of many strong beings.

One Forbidden Zone Master after another watched from afar, refraining from acting immediately, intending to use the You Clan supremes to gauge the true state of Emperor Tianyuan.

If it was merely a bluff, they wouldn’t be too late to take action.

…

Outside the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

Suddenly, the sky darkened, and a terrifying pressure descended upon them.

All the followers patrolling the palace felt a tingling sensation on their scalps. Such supreme majesty, if not for the formation restrictions isolating them, they would have already knelt down.

Even so.

All the followers were filled with dread and unease.

A supreme suddenly arriving now was definitely not good news.

“Tianyuan.”

At this moment, a low, chilling voice came, echoing in the ears of all the followers, cold and ruthless, “Come out and meet your death!”
